title: fix(components): the docs flow embed names the flow and its approval steps in the reader's language
body:

_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XP3RHGWUG7UH3fNa4tBa9UC)_

Part of #35979 (Asked item 1 only; Asked item 2, a translation key for decision / notify / start / end node labels, stays open on the card for a ruling)

repo:objectstack#4 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5okniknzVVR3KTSVr1

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：非英文读者打开带流程嵌入的使用手册时，流程标题和审批步骤名改用读者语言显示（例如「大额商机审批」「销售经理审核」）；包里没有译文的地方仍显示原文。
- 为什么做：HotCRM 中文手册里的审批流程图标题和步骤全是英文，而包里已带中文译文；这是此前 Studio 流程设计器同类修复未覆盖的文档查看器。
- 出错会怎样：只影响显示，最坏情况是某个步骤仍显示原文；不改任何数据，可直接撤回。开始、判断、通知、结束这几类步骤目前规格里没有译文位置，仍显示原文，等卡上第二项的裁决。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

- **The docs viewer's flow embed reads the package's flow labels.** `FlowView` in `element:metadata_viewer` now draws the flow title from `flows.FLOW.label` and each `approval` step from `flows.FLOW.approvals.NODE_ID.label`, in the reader's language, and falls back to the authored label (then the name / node id) where the bundle has no entry. Only those two reads changed (`flow.label`, `n.label`), through one hook call, so the sibling branch for the same view (branches and conditions) merges around them.
- **One resolver, moved, not copied.** The Studio designer's resolver lived in `@object-ui/app-shell`, which `@object-ui/components` cannot import. It now lives in `@object-ui/i18n`, beside the provider whose resource tree it reads:
  - `flowsBundle.ts`: `activeFlowsBundle` and its types, moved whole from the app-shell utils module (only the docblock changed).
  - `flowLabels.ts`: `flowLabelTranslations` and `useFlowLabelTranslations`, moved from the Studio module. The flow label still goes through the spec's `translateFlow`; the step label is still read for `approval` nodes only.
  - The Studio module keeps its own parts (the Automations rail reader and the canvas context) and re-exports the moved ones, so its call sites are unchanged. `FlowRunner` imports the reader from `@object-ui/i18n`.
- **Which steps can be translated.** The spec's `flows.FLOW` group has a label key only for `approval` steps (`screens.NODE_ID.title` is a screen's heading, not its node label). A start, decision, notify or end step keeps its authored label: that is Asked item 2, a spec question left to the card.
- No spec change, no server change. `GET /meta/flow` is unchanged; the embed reads the bundle the console already loads.

## Read first (by risk)

1. `ui/packages/i18n/src/flowLabels.ts` and `flowsBundle.ts`: the moved resolver; check nothing but the docblocks changed against the app-shell originals.
2. `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/basic/metadata-viewer.tsx`, the `FlowView` hunk: the hook is called before the early returns.
3. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/flow-label-translations.tsx`: what stays in Studio, and the re-export.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/components/src/__tests__/metadata-viewer.test.tsx`; expect 11 passed, including the two tests under "flow embed: package label translations".

## Tests

<details><summary>Pins (one new top-level describe in the existing viewer harness)</summary>

`metadata-viewer.test.tsx`, describe "element:metadata_viewer flow embed: package label translations (flows.FLOW.label, approvals.STEP.label)", with a real `createI18n` instance loaded from a zh-CN `TranslationData` through `transformSpecTranslations`, inside `I18nProvider`:

- an `opportunity_approval`-shaped flow draws 大额商机审批, 销售经理审核 and 销售总监签批, and none of the English approval labels; the start, decision, notify and end steps keep their authored labels;
- a bundle entry for the flow without its label and without one step falls back to the authored flow label and the authored step label; a bundle that translates only another flow leaves everything authored.

The Studio pins in `FlowCanvas.test.tsx` (the resolver's unit test and the canvas and inspector readings) now exercise the moved resolver unchanged; only one import line moved.

The dispatch suggested a new card-named test file; AGENTS.md puts a new pin for a component with a shared harness into that file as a top-level describe, so it went there.
</details>

<details><summary>Runs</summary>

- At 1ffd047104 (resolver in one i18n module): `vitest run` of `metadata-viewer.test.tsx` and `FlowCanvas.test.tsx` under the verify lock: `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 40 passed (40)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n --filter @object-ui/components run type-check` (both `tsc` programs each) at eccfc7d638: `Done` for both, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- Ablation at 1ffd047104 through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: the hook call replaced by an `undefined` value of the same type (anchor 1 to 0, blob 4be3f23d52b0 to 475415c28f24). Result: `Tests 2 failed | 9 passed (11)`, both new tests red, the nine others green. Restored: blob 4be3f23d52b0 equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- NOT MEASURED locally at the final head 7e3d2b7aae, reason: the shared verify lock was held by another lane's run for more than 75 minutes and five acquisitions of 540s / 300s timed out. The last commit splits the i18n module in two (`activeFlowsBundle` into `flowsBundle.ts`) with no behaviour change. Declared to CI: `Type Check UI` (app-shell, i18n and components type-check) and `Test UI` (the two pinned files, the FlowRunner and i18n suites, `ui/scripts/`).
- `@object-ui/app-shell` type-check: NOT MEASURED locally (same reason), declared to `Type Check UI`.

## Acceptance notes

- **Overlap with #36316 (stage confirms name the flows a move would start).** That draft also moves `activeFlowsBundle` from app-shell into `@object-ui/i18n` as `flowsBundle.ts` with the same package-entry export. This branch moves it to the same path with the same export lines and the same `FlowRunner` and `FlowCanvas.test.tsx` hunks, so the second lander resolves only three small conflicts: the `flowsBundle.ts` docblock, the comment above the entry export, and the Studio module. `overlap-check` names exactly those three files. The second lander keeps one `activeFlowsBundle` export.
- **Measurement for Asked item 2 (not built).** hotcrm `opportunity_approval` (hotcrm 01d3ec4): 13 nodes; 11 drawn at the default business altitude; 2 have a key (`approval`), 9 do not: 1 start, 3 decision, 4 notify, 1 end. Showcase `allFlows` (33 flows, this branch's base): 123 top-level nodes drawn at business altitude; 15 `approval` steps have a key; the rest have none (33 start, 41 end, 13 notify, 6 decision, 3 loop, 2 each of map, subflow, parallel, try_catch, and 1 each of wait, screen, save_notice, approval_revise).
- The embed's subtitle is the authored `flow.description`; the spec's `flows` group has no description key, so it stays authored.
- No `content/docs` page documents the viewer (only its ADR, a governed surface), so no docs page changed.
- Changeset: `@object-ui/components` and `@object-ui/i18n` patch. `@object-ui/app-shell` is private and its behaviour is unchanged.
